rows.en: Defeat all Crave units in 2 minutes
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: We're still on our way back, but HQ has sent us a new mission.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Since Granada fell, the Titans have raided civilian colonies again and again.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: This time, we'll lure them into <mk(-25,-25,7,1)><ar(0,7,1)>traps set <pic(0)><cs(3)>in a civilian colony<ce()> and <mk(50,-45,6,3,50)><ar(0,6,3,200)><mk(37.5,37.5,7,3,150)><ar(0,7,3,200)><mk(-45,50,0,0,200)><ar(0,0,0,200)>wipe out the Titans.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: HQ is running this operation. Civilians are evacuated and the <pic(1)><cs(3)>interception traps<ce()> set.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We're told not to worry about damage to the surroundings... but I can't agree with that.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Since our orders say to fight inside the colony, we have no choice but to obey, but
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: I want you to do all you can to avoid causing damage. All units, prepare to sortie.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: The operation was a success. That's only what they deserve for rebelling against the UCE.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: Space is a precious source of resources. We won't let them do as they please.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: With the next operation, we should finally start to see the end of them.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: What worries me more is the colonies. Lately, many of their people have turned defiant.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: This operation was also meant to keep people like that in check.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: If we don't show our strength here, they'll only grow more and more arrogant.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: I want you to understand that it is all for the sake of order in the Earth Sphere.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: Anyone who opposes our UCE will be brought to their knees.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: So you're just a ragtag unit after all. I was a fool to expect anything of you.
rows.speaker: UCE official?
